stem:
Which group contains coloured ions out of following

$\text{Cu}^{2+}$ $\text{Ti}^{4+}$ $\text{Co}^{2+}$ $\text{Fe}^{2+}$

Identify correct statements from below:

I. The chromate ion is square planar.
II. Dichromates are generally prepared from chromates.
III. The green manganate ion is diamagnetic.
IV. Dark green coloured $\text{K}_2\text{MnO}_4$ disproportionates in a neutral or acidic medium to give permanganate.
V. With increasing oxidation number of transition metal, ionic character of the oxides decreases.

Choose the correct answer from the option given below:
solution:
(I) $\text{CrO}_4^{2-}$ is tetrahedral

(II) $2\text{Na}_2\text{CrO}_4 + 2\text{H}^+ \rightarrow \text{Na}_2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7 + 2\text{Na}^+ + \text{H}_2\text{O}$

(III) Green manganate is paramagnetic with 1 unpaired electron.

(IV) $3\text{MnO}_4^{2-} + 4\text{H}^+ \rightarrow 2\text{MnO}_4^- + \text{MnO}_2 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$

(V) As the oxidation state increases, ionic character decreases.

stem:
In the following series of reactions identify the major products A & B respectively.

Bromobenzene $\xrightarrow{\text{SO}_3/\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4}$ A (major product) $\xrightarrow{\text{Br}_2/\text{Fe}}$ B (major product)
solution:
Bromobenzene undergoes sulphonation at the para position (major) to give 4-bromobenzenesulfonic acid (A). Bromination then occurs ortho to Br and meta to $\text{SO}_3\text{H}$, giving 3,4-dibromobenzenesulfonic acid (B).

Both reactions are electrophilic substitutions: first sulphonation, then halogenation. –Br is o-/p-directing and gives the para product, while $\text{SO}_3\text{H}$ is meta directing; their cumulative directive influence gives B.
notes: Reaction scheme and all options are structure drawings in the source; transcribed as IUPAC names.
